rationale: The most recent 1-minute candle expanded to 88.33 on the highest volume of the last five bars, closed well off its lows, and broke the prior tight 88.05-88.17 consolidation, indicating emerging buy interest right at the 9-EMA. Price sits at only 20.7% of the daily range after the gap-down open yet has produced four consecutive small-range candles followed by this bullish expansion while SPY is positive and VIXY is down over 2%. These mechanical shifts erode the original inability-to-hold-advances thesis enough to warrant exiting the short with the modest 0.33% gain intact.
